summary: refactor(shared): move fxa-shared subscriptions to a legacy lib
description:
Because:

* fxa-shared subscriptions and dto/auth/payments must move to a lib
  so that later tickets can remove fxa-shared

This commit:

* Moves them to libs/accounts/subscriptions-legacy
* Keeps re-export shims at the old fxa-shared paths
* Points auth-server and admin-server importers at the lib alias
* Removes fxa-shared files that main deleted and a rebase restored

Closes FXA-10672
